title: spec(automation): a `{token}` at a flow value slot or text slot passes `FlowSchema.parse` and `defineStack`, while `registerFlow` and every run refuse it — the slot judges never run at the parse
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a reachable defect**, the same class #23260 closes for the typed keys ("a build door passes what every run refuses"), at the slots. `reach:` `defineStack` and `FlowSchema.parse`, measured by the #23260 dev at the base and at PR #23319's head (`os-dev-report` on #23260, out-of-scope finding 1); the metadata save door and `os compile`'s stack parse by the same parse. Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/spec/src/automation`, `domain:spec`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at the review of PR #23319. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

- A `{token}` at a value slot or a text slot is ACCEPTED by `FlowSchema.parse` and `defineStack`: measured with `create_record` `fields.title: '{record.name}'`, `screen` `recordId: '{x}'`, `notify` `title` template `'{name}'` and `http` `url: '{id}'`.
- `registerFlow` refuses each one (probed through the shipped engine), and every run refuses each one, because the node contracts compose the slot judges.
- The value-slot and text-slot judges run at `registerFlow`, `os validate` and the executors, and never inside `FlowSchema`'s `superRefine`. `flow-value-slot-template.ts`'s module doc names exactly those doors ("`AutomationEngine.registerFlow`, `objectstack validate` and the executors call it"), so the gap may have been a staging choice of #19939, not an oversight. After #23260 the typed keys are refused at the parse while the slots are not, so the two arms of one node's config are judged at different doors.

## Wanted

- Either the slot judges run where the typed-key judge runs (`FlowSchema`'s refinement), so `defineStack`, the save door and `os compile` refuse a slot token as `registerFlow` does, each reported once and located; or the owning seat measures and states why the parse must not run them, and the module doc says so.
- Pins at `defineStack` for one value-slot and one text-slot token, with a negative control.

Order: after PR #23319 lands (its "reported once" exemption reads the same two judges).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `defineStack FlowSchema parse accepts value slot text slot token registerFlow refuses build door` → 18 hits. #23260 (open, PR #23319) is the typed-key arm. #21982, #17495, #22110, #15811 and #15807 (closed) are earlier "a door passes what another refuses" cards on other keys and slots; #20618, #15793, #22748 and #16835 (closed) are other stack-parse questions. None is this.

Dedupe words: defineStack slot token accepted; FlowSchema value slot judge not called; text slot token passes save door; registerFlow refuses defineStack accepts.
